Path of the bundled FISHMORPH trait table

Source: R/space-app.R
fishmorph_space_data.Rd

Returns the path of the CSV used by default by launch_fishmorph_space(), to inspect it or read it directly.

Usage

fishmorph_space_data(source = NULL)

Arguments

source

Which measurement campaign to point at: "segment" (the published table) or "landmark" (traits recomputed from the landmark re-digitization). NULL (default) follows getOption("fishmorph.source", "segment"), see set_fishmorph_source().

Value

A file path (character string), or "" when the requested table is not bundled – which is the normal state of the landmark table until build_fishmorph_landmark_table() has been run.

Details

A reminder: its trait columns are ALREADY log10(x + 1). Reading them back to project new individuals therefore needs no further transformation, and applying one would distort the projection.

See also

set_fishmorph_source(), load_fishmorph_reference()

Examples

p <- fishmorph_space_data()
if (nzchar(p)) utils::head(utils::read.csv(p, sep = ";"), 3)
